transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I just feel completely drained, like my body’s out of batteries or something. Even walking from my car into the clinic felt like a lot, and at work, just opening the EHR feels like it takes everything I have. It’s weird because it’s such a small thing, you know, just clicking around on a computer, but it feels like climbing a hill.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends, don’t interest you as much anymore?

I don’t know, honestly. I haven’t really thought about it that way. Like, I still scroll on my phone sometimes, but I don’t know if that counts as enjoying something or just passing time. My friends have been busy too, so it’s hard to tell if I’m avoiding stuff or if schedules just don’t line up. I guess I’m not sure.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?

Yeah… I think so. After my energy dropped like that, I started feeling kind of empty most days, and hopeless, like I’d already messed up my whole future in healthcare before it even really started. I keep thinking about how I’m only 18 and I’m supposed to be building toward something, but it feels like I already ruined it somehow. And then I get stuck on that thought, like even at work when I’m just supposed to be doing basic stuff.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has it been going on for more than two weeks, or did it start more recently?

It’s definitely been more than two weeks. I mean, I keep trying to think of when it really started, because days kind of blur together, especially with work and just getting through stuff. But the depressed, guilty, exhausted feeling has been going on for… maybe about nine months now, since after I kind of crashed from that high-energy stretch before. It didn’t just start recently.
Have you had this depressed mood or low energy for most of the time over the past two years?

Not over the whole two years, no… I don’t think so. It’s more like the depressed, guilty, just completely drained part has been going on for about nine months, since I crashed after that really high-energy stretch. Before that, I mean, things were different, but this specific low feeling hasn’t been most of two years.
Have you had periods of depression in the past that lasted for at least a couple of weeks, before this current nine-month period started?

I’m not really sure. Like, I’ve had bad weeks before, I guess, but I don’t know if I’d call them depression or if they lasted long enough like that. School was stressful sometimes, and I’d get into these moods where I just didn’t want to deal with people, but then something would happen and I’d be distracted, or I’d have work, or… I don’t know.

So before this current thing, I can’t really point to a clear couple-week period and say, yeah, that was the same. This one feels more obvious because it just kept going.
Before this current nine-month period, was there ever a time when you felt depressed or had low energy for at least two weeks straight?

I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had times before where I was tired or down, but I can’t honestly tell if it was two weeks straight or just a bad stretch, you know? Sometimes everything kind of runs together, especially with school and work and just trying to keep up with people asking if I’m okay.

So… before this current nine months, I can’t point to one clear time and say yes, that was definitely at least two weeks.
Have you had more than one time in your life when you felt this way—depressed, low, or completely drained—for at least a couple of weeks?

I don’t know about more than one time, honestly. The clearest one is after all that energy just dropped off… that’s when I started feeling empty most days, like hopeless, like I’d already ruined everything before I even got anywhere with healthcare.

I mean, I’d be at work or thinking about work and just feel like, what’s the point, I already messed up my future. Before that, I can’t really separate it out into “this was another couple weeks” or not. This one is the one that feels real and obvious.

Have you ever had another time, separate from this current nine-month period, when you felt just as down, hopeless, or drained for at least a couple of weeks—and that time was also separated by a period of several weeks or months where you felt more like your usual self?

I don’t think I can separate out another one like that, not clearly. The main time I can talk about is after all that energy dropped off, and then I just felt… empty most days. Like hopeless, like I’d already ruined my whole future in healthcare before it even really started.

Before that, I mean, I had bad stretches, but I can’t really say there was another whole separate period and then I was normal for months or something. It’s all kind of blurry when I try to line it up.

Can you think back to a time before this current nine-month period when you felt just as down, hopeless, or drained for at least a couple of weeks—and was there a time after that when you felt more like your usual self for at least two months?

I mean… I keep trying to think of one before this, but I can’t really pin it down like that. The one I remember clearly is after all that energy dropped, I started feeling empty and hopeless most days, like I’d already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started.

Before that, I don’t know… there were bad stretches, but I can’t say there was a clear couple weeks like that and then two months where I was back to normal. It’s kind of all mixed up in my head.

Can you think of any other time, before this current nine-month period, when you felt just as down, hopeless, or drained for at least a couple of weeks—and then after that time, you felt more like your usual self for at least two months?

I’m trying to think, but I keep coming back to the same thing. Like, after all that energy dropped, that’s when I started feeling really empty most days, and hopeless… like I’d already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started.

Before that, I don’t know. I can remember feeling bad here and there, but my head kind of jumps around when I try to put it on a timeline. Like I start thinking about work and whether people could tell something was off, and then I lose the thread. So I can’t really say there was another clear separate time before this where it was that bad for weeks and then I was normal for two months.

Before this current time, have you ever had another period—separate from this current nine-month stretch—where you felt just as down, hopeless, or drained for at least two weeks, and that time was also followed by a period where you felt more like your usual self for at least a couple of months?

I know you’re asking if there was a whole separate time before this, with like a break after it, but I honestly keep circling back to the same period. After all that energy dropped, I just started feeling empty most days, really hopeless, like I’d already messed up my whole future in healthcare before I even got started.

Before that… I mean, I can’t clearly point to another separate two-week stretch and then say I was normal for a couple months. I get lost trying to sort it out.

Before this current nine-month period, have you ever had at least one other time when you felt just as down, hopeless, or drained for at least two weeks—and that time was followed by a period where you felt more like your usual self for at least a couple of months?

I don’t think I can say yes to that. I’ve been trying to line it up in my head, but it gets messy. Like, I’ll start thinking about whether there was a bad stretch before, and then I’m suddenly remembering school stuff or work shifts or how I was acting around people, and I lose the actual timeline.

So… no, not that I can clearly identify. I don’t have a separate earlier time I can point to where it was that bad for two weeks and then I was really back to normal for a couple months.

Before this current time, have you ever had another episode of feeling this way—down, hopeless, or drained—for at least two weeks, and then after that episode, you felt back to normal for at least two full months?

Yeah… I know you’re asking if there was another separate episode before this, with like a clear “then I was normal again” afterward. I keep trying to separate it out, but honestly I mostly just come back to what happened after all that energy dropped. That’s when I started feeling empty and hopeless most days, like I’d already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started.

Before that, I can’t really pin down another time like that with a full two months where I was back to normal after. My thoughts kind of wander when I try to put it in order.

Before this current time, was there ever a period where you had a few weeks of feeling really down, hopeless, or completely drained — and then after that, you had at least two months where you felt clearly better and more like your usual self?

I’m trying to answer that straight, but I keep getting stuck on the same part. After all that energy dropped, I just started feeling… empty most days, and really hopeless. Like I’d already ruined my future in healthcare before it even really started.

Before that, I don’t know—I start thinking about old school stuff and shifts and people asking what I was going to do with my life, and then I lose the thread. I can’t clearly say there was another separate few-week period and then two months where I was definitely back to myself.

Before this current time, have you ever had a period where you felt down, hopeless, or drained for at least two weeks, and then after that, you had at least two months where you felt clearly better and more like your usual self?

I mean… the part I can really put a time on is this current one. After I crashed from that high-energy stretch, I’ve been down and guilty and exhausted for about nine months now.

Before that, I keep trying to think if there was another separate thing with two months of feeling normal after, but I don’t really have that clear in my head. It’s more this last nine months that stands out.

Before this current time, have you ever had a period where you felt down, hopeless, or drained for at least two weeks — and then after that, you had at least two months where you felt clearly better and more like your usual self?

I don’t think I can say yes to that clearly. I keep trying to line it up like… “this was two weeks, then this was two months better,” but my brain starts jumping around to different times, like school and work and whether I was handling things okay, and then I’m not sure what counts.

So… no, not that I can really identify. I don’t have a clean memory of a separate down period and then being clearly back to myself for two months.

Before this current time, have you ever had a period where you felt down, hopeless, or drained most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks straight—and during that time, you had trouble with things like sleep, appetite, or concentration?

I’m not sure. I know you’re asking about before now, like a separate stretch, but when I try to think back it gets blurry. I can remember times I was tired or stressed, especially with school and work and trying to keep up with everything, but I don’t know if it was most of the day nearly every day for two full weeks.

And with sleep or concentration… I mean, I’ve had nights where I didn’t sleep great, but I can’t really pin it to a specific period like that. So I don’t want to say yes if I’m just guessing.
